svg.title: Geerlings compact resonator - design A
svg.desc: The paper text does not specify capacitor-finger or inductor-turn counts. Design A uses the counts visible in the Fig. 1 schematic (14 IDC fingers and 10 half-width spans per inductor side); B/C counts are reconstruction assumptions constrained by their reported envelopes. Change the counts when mask data or a target L/C is available.
